title: Life of a $100 online order
subtitle: What the acquirer does, from checkout to a dispute weeks later

sections.heading: Checkout
points: Shopper pays on the merchant's site
Gateway sends an auth request: MID, amount, card or token

sections.heading: Authorization
points: Switch routes by BIN to the card network
Issuer approves and places a hold

sections.heading: Capture
points: Order ships, merchant marks it for capture
Batch closes at end of day

sections.heading: Funding
points: Sales minus refunds, chargebacks, fees, reserves

takeaway: One sale makes records in every layer for weeks. Join them on the transaction reference.
footer: Illustrative timing. Based on the merchant-services-guide in this repo, compiled from public sources.
